{{Top|leg}}
'''Binka fruit''' was a type of edible [[Fruit/Legends|fruit]] which grew on [[Binka]] [[Tree/Legends|trees]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Agamar/Legends|Agamar]]. A thick slice of binka fruit was used in [[Agamar slider]]s at [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]] on the planet [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].
